subject: Mechanical Engineering
title: Thrust Bearings: Carrying Axial Loads
description: A tiny lesson with a big payoff: Thrust Bearings: Carrying Axial Loads.

hook.text: A ship propeller pushes forward. Something must absorb that thrust.

buildup.text: Thrust bearings sit perpendicular to the shaft, carrying loads along it.

discovery.text: Flat washers with balls or rollers let the shaft push and spin freely.

twist.text: Tilting-pad designs create an oil wedge that lifts the shaft off metal.

climax.text: Hydro turbines spin on giant thrust bearings holding hundreds of tons.

punchline.text: Thrust bearings let shafts push without grinding.

quiz.question: How does a tilting-pad thrust bearing reduce friction?
options: Tilting pads create an oil wedge that lifts the shaft off the surface
Magnets levitate the shaft above the bearing
Pads are coated with Teflon to reduce contact friction
